mentions.name: exocomp
mentions.description: This agentic environment focuses on short-lived agents and sandboxing: a planner spawns short-lived agents so models with low temperature settings can each concentrate on a single task without overflowing context and produce good, readable code. It only supports Go, leveraging unified formatting, codestyle, testing methodologies, and core packages to save system prompt tokens. Current work includes a summarizer agent and requirements specifications that check for valid Go syntax using the upstream parser and ast package.
mentions.problem: Models handling multiple tasks in one long context overflow and produce worse output; short-lived, sandboxed agents keep each model focused on a single task.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on my own agentic environment that focuses on short lived agents and sandboxing. Agents are short lived and are spawned by the planner you're interacting with. This way models with low temp settings can focus on a single task, don't overflow, and produce actually good and readable code.
